verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents the OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Flow: the device passes its Client ID to start authorization, and the user approves it via a link on another device (auth0-docs-9, auth0-docs-40). Auth0's own MCP Server uses this flow to authenticate AI tools like Claude Desktop, a first-party example of headless agent auth without pasted secrets (auth0-docs-13). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, device-flow docs aimed explicitly at CLIs and agents rather than smart TVs and consoles, and detail on token lifetime and refresh for long-running agents.
